info.hotelText: The hotel is where your workers live when they're not assigned to a floor. They wait here until you send them to work.
info.seatsText: Seats — total number of rooms available. Free — how many rooms are vacant. When the hotel is full, no new workers will appear.
info.levelText: Level (1–9) determines how fast a worker produces goods on a floor. Higher level means faster production.
info.dreamText: Every worker has an ideal job. Assigning them to a floor with that production type gives a speed bonus.
info.arrowText: This worker is a better candidate for their floor than whoever is currently assigned there — either by type match or higher level.
info.actionsText: Find Job opens the floor picker to assign this worker. Evict permanently removes them from the hotel.

hotelPanel.elevatorHint: Ride guests in the elevator — workers sometimes appear on the way!

categoryDesc.buy: Buy goods for your floors to restock production

categoryDesc.collect: Collect earned coins from completed sales
categoryDesc.elevator: Transport visitors between floors in the elevator

info.ranksText: Each category has 7 ranks to unlock by reaching in-game milestones — buying goods, lifting visitors, collecting revenue, and more.
info.gemsText: Completing each rank earns gems. Higher ranks give more gems per completion.
info.bonusText: Some ranks also grant a permanent income or XP bonus that applies to all future earnings.

dailyTasks.title: Daily Tasks
dailyTasks.doubleRewardHint: Complete 7 tasks today to earn ×2 rewards tomorrow!
dailyTasks.goalReachedSub: Tomorrow all your task rewards will be doubled ×2

info.challengesText: Complete 11 tasks each day: buy, list, and collect goods, lift visitors and VIPs, add residents, spend gems, purchase diamonds, and more.
info.rewardsText: Each completed task gives coins and building materials (bricks, glass, nails, screws).
info.tokensText: Tasks also reward colored tokens used to upgrade your business categories in My Business.
info.bonusText: Complete 7 tasks to unlock double rewards for the following day. Resets at midnight.

myBusiness.title: My Business
myBusiness.subtitle: Upgrade categories to increase profit on floors

info.categoriesText: Each floor type (green, blue, yellow, purple, red) is a category. Upgrade them to boost earnings on all floors of that type.
info.tokensText: Spend colored tokens to upgrade a category. Each token color matches a specific floor type. Tokens are earned from daily tasks.
info.bonusText: Each upgrade adds +5% to coins earned when collecting goods from that floor type.
info.maxText: Each category can be upgraded up to level 40, for a maximum bonus of +200%.
